changes.oldText: Custom dashboard panels: Lets you add your own custom panels to the Dashboard page, each showing a data source you choose, narrowed by a condition you define. The panels appear only while this feature is enabled; turning it off later hides them without deleting them, and turning it back on restores them exactly as they were. See Custom Panels for how to add and manage them.
